Se cambia el tipo de estas entidades en: The type of these entities is changed in the graph. It is reversible: each change can be undone under “Applied”.
Se cerró la sesión en el resto de dispos: You were signed out on all other devices.
Se completa lo que haya cambiado, se pau: Whatever changed is completed, vector writes (ingestion, index, documents) are paused for a moment and all vectors are swapped in one operation. If anything fails, everything stays on the previous engine.
Se crea un token nuevo con el mismo nomb: A new token is created with the same name, role, scope and lifetime. The previous one keeps working during the grace period, so there is time to update the agent that uses it, and then it expires.
Se elimina el hecho del grafo y de la li: The fact is removed from the graph and from the fact list of its episodes. If it simply stopped being true, use “Invalidate”, which keeps the history. You will be able to undo it right afterwards.
Se eliminan el original, el texto extraí: The original, the extracted text and all its chunks are removed from the index. This cannot be undone.
Se genera un enlace de un solo uso para: A single-use link is generated for them to choose their password; if email is configured it is also sent to them.
Se guarda cifrada y no se vuelve a mostr: It is stored encrypted and is not shown again.
Se guarda cifrado y no se vuelve a mostr: It is stored encrypted and is not shown again.

Se prepara como un trabajo. El paquete s: It is prepared as a job. The package can be downloaded once and is deleted when downloaded; if nobody downloads it, it expires after {{h}} hours.

Se quitan la fuente y sus {{documents}}: The source and its {{documents}} documents are removed from the index. The files in the folder or the wiki pages are not touched.
Se reemplazan los tipos, las relaciones,: The current types, relations, map and instructions are replaced by those of the pack, including changes made by hand. Entities already in the graph do not change.
Se usan las variables MIMIRSYNTH_EMBEDDI: Using the MIMIRSYNTH_EMBEDDING_* variables from .env (changing them requires restarting the API). An engine added here takes precedence over them.
Se usan las variables MIMIRSYNTH_LLM_* d: Using the MIMIRSYNTH_LLM_* variables from .env (changing them requires restarting the API). An engine added here takes precedence over them.
Se vuelve a usar la imagen de tu proveed: The image from your identity provider, or your initials, is used again.
Servidor de correo saliente. Se usa para: Outgoing mail server. It is used to send invitations and password recovery links.

Sin decisores: toda propuesta de un cola: No deciders: every contributor proposal waits for a curator.

Sin motores. Mientras no haya ninguno se: No engines. While there are none, the MIMIRSYNTH_LLM_* variables are used if they exist; otherwise, ingestion is disabled.

Un alias hace que un nombre de relación: An alias makes one relation name read as another (HostedOn as HOSTED_ON), when reading and when ingesting, without changing the graph's data; it can be removed. They are created with «Unify with…» in Relations.

Una propuesta con un secreto seguro se r: A proposal with a certain secret is rejected with a message saying which type it is, and a document with one is not indexed. Possible ones are flagged.

Una tarea diaria purga lo que supera est: A daily job purges what is older than these periods and leaves a summary.
